FINDINGS.status_before: FLAKY (failed 2 of 4 full-suite runs; passed in isolation)
FINDINGS.kind: test-harness defect, NOT a ledger defect
FINDINGS.root_cause: threading.Barrier(20) with 100 tasks on a 20-worker pool ran in five waves. On a loaded machine one slow wave exceeded barrier.wait(timeout=5), which breaks a Barrier permanently, so every later wave raised BrokenBarrierError. Characterisation run over 6 attempts: 1 failure, 80 of 100 workers raising BrokenBarrierError, and zero sqlite/busy/linearizability errors of any kind.
FINDINGS.fix: replaced the wave barrier with a single threading.Event start gate and explicit future submission, so all 20 concurrent workers are released at once. Contention is unchanged and all three assertions (errors == [], vote_count == 5, ACCEPTED rows == 5) are untouched.
FINDINGS.product_impact: none — no write path, lock, or aggregate behaviour was changed; the concurrency guarantee itself never failed.
